title: Cyberbullying
summary: Cyberbullying is harassment through digital platforms — insults, threats, spreading rumours or sharing images. Don't engage; block, save evidence and report.
steps: Block and report on the platform
Report serious threats to cybercrime police
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
